content.study:
Tort liability may be discharged by death where the claim is personal and not saved by statute, by accord and satisfaction, release, judgment, limitation or another recognised legal event.\
\
The historical actio personalis rule was modified by Indian legislation. Settlement and release, merger in judgment and limitation may also extinguish or bar claims. Discharge is distinct from a defence on the merits.
